inputs.name: prometheus_version
inputs.description: Prometheus release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release tarball for each architecture, from the release's sha256sums.txt. Change these with prometheus_version.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address and port Prometheus serves its UI and API on. ":9090" listens on every address.

inputs.name: scrape_interval
inputs.description: How often Prometheus scrapes every target and evaluates rules, such as "15s" or "1m".

inputs.name: retention
inputs.description: How long Prometheus keeps samples before deleting them, such as "15d" or "90d".

inputs.name: scrape_targets
inputs.description: Scrape jobs: a map of job names to lists of HOST:PORT targets, such as { node = ["10.0.0.5:9100"] }. Prometheus always scrapes itself as the prometheus job.

inputs.name: extra_args
inputs.description: More command-line flags for Prometheus, such as ["--web.enable-admin-api"].
